General information, not legal advice.

Website content is provided for general information. It does not address the full facts of any person’s circumstances and should not be relied on as legal advice. Laws, procedures and regulatory guidance may change.

Visiting this site or sending an email does not by itself create an advocate-client relationship. The firm must complete appropriate checks, agree the scope of work and confirm an engagement before acting.

Insight links lead to independent publishers or platforms. They are provided to identify Susan Mute’s published commentary and relevant public sources. The firm does not control the continued availability or privacy practices of third-party sites.

Accuracy and responsible use.

Reasonable care is taken with the information on this site, but no guarantee is made that general content is complete or suitable for a particular matter. Seek advice based on your own facts and deadlines.
